title: RegEx bug: does not match lookaheads with patterns that could match more than 255 characters
body:
### Tested versions

- Godot version: 6.4.1. (most recent stable)
- GDScript RegEx class

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 30.0.101.1994) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1165G7 @ 2.80GHz (8 threads) - 15.78 GiB memory

### Issue description

Regex Lookaheads in Godot apparently only support patterns that can match at most 255 characters.

Does not depend on the subject string or the number of actually matched characters. The lookahead simply never matches as soon as the pattern is not bounded inside 0 to 255 characters.

### Expected Behaviour

The lookahead allows for any valid patterns, even those not bounded inside 0 to 255 characters.

If the lookahead practically fails to match after matching 255 characters, this should be mentioned in the official documentation entry of the RegEx class.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new scene with one Node3D
2. add a script with the below code to the node
3. run the current scene

```gdscript
extends Node3D

var regex_tests = {
	"(?<=^.{0,3})a": "abcda",
	"(?<=^.{0,4})a": "abcda",
	"(?<=^.{0,10})a": "abcda",
	"(?<=^.{0,100})a": "abcda",
	"(?<=^.{0,255})a": "abcda",
	"(?<=^.{0,256})a": "abcda",
	"(?<=^.{0,255}.{0,1})a": "abcda",
	"(?<=^.{0,1000})a": "abcda",
	"(?<=^.{0,})a": "abcda",
	"a(?=.{0,3}$)": "abcda",
	"a(?=.{0,4}$)": "abcda",
	"a(?=.{0,10}$)": "abcda",
	"a(?=.{0,100}$)": "abcda",
	"a(?=.{0,255}$)": "abcda",
	"a(?=.{0,256}$)": "abcda",
	"a(?=.{0,255}.{0,1}$)": "abcda",
	"a(?=.{0,1000}$)": "abcda",
	"a(?=.{0,}$)": "abcda",
}

func _ready() -> void:
	
	for key in regex_tests.keys():
		
		var subject_string = regex_tests[key]
		var regex = RegEx.create_from_string(key)
		var matches = regex.search_all(subject_string)
		var display_text = ", ".join(PackedStringArray(matches.map(func(m: RegExMatch): return m.get_string())))
		print("test pattern: ", key, "; subject: ", subject_string, "; matches: ", display_text)

```

#### expected output

```
test pattern: (?<=^.{0,3})a; subject: abcda; matches: a
test pattern: (?<=^.{0,4})a; subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: (?<=^.{0,10})a; subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: (?<=^.{0,100})a; subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: (?<=^.{0,255})a; subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: (?<=^.{0,256})a; subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: (?<=^.{0,255}.{0,1})a; subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: (?<=^.{0,1000})a; subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: (?<=^.{0,})a; subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: (?<=^.*)a; subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: (?<=^.+)a; subject: abcda; matches: a
test pattern: a(?=.{0,3}$); subject: abcda; matches: a
test pattern: a(?=.{0,4}$); subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: a(?=.{0,10}$); subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: a(?=.{0,100}$); subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: a(?=.{0,255}$); subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: a(?=.{0,256}$); subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: a(?=.{0,255}.{0,1}$); subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: a(?=.{0,1000}$); subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: a(?=.{0,}$); subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: a(?=.*$); subject: abcda; matches: a,a
test pattern: a(?=.+$); subject: abcda; matches: a

```

#### actual output
